mission: To ensure every local business has the visibility, technology, and personal support they need to thrive in the age of AI search.
aboutText: At Hill Stack Studio, we pair personal consulting with Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) to help our local businesses stand out on traditional search engines like Google and next-generation AI platforms like ChatGPT, Copilot, Perplexity, and Gemini.

services.name: Custom Web Design & Development
services.description: Clean and modern website redesigns engineered to build trust, drive action and deliver maximum user engagement.

services.name: Generative Engine Optimization (GEO)
services.description: Comprehensive optimization and auditing for traditional search engines and AI tools like ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Gemini to maximize your local visibility.

services.name: Consulting & Site Migration
services.description: Plain-English strategic guidance for local business owners and seamless site transfers with zero downtime.

services.name: Web Hosting & Administration
services.description: Ensuring your site is well maintained means you won't let your digital presence fall by the wayside.

services.name: Search Engine Readiness
services.description: Structuring your website's data into a clean, machine-readable format so AI assistants can accurately recommend your business.

services.name: Copywriting & Content Adjustments
services.description: Improve brand messaging with search-optimized copy designed to drive customer conversion.

services.name: Performance & Visibility Audit
services.description: In-depth analysis of speed benchmarks, mobile responsiveness, search indexation, and AI engine discoverability.

services.name: Accessibility Compliance
services.description: WCAG compliant web standards ensuring inclusivity, legal protection, and a seamless usability experience for all visitors.

services.name: Security & Privacy Compliance
services.description: Robust security measures, privacy compliance, and site protection standards to safeguard your business and customer data.
